about.title: A Dream of a Natural, Simple Life Amid Greenery
about.lead: TrendEv is the sister brand of TrendArsa Investment Office's "Land From You, Home From Us" system, bringing together garden home and villa projects.
about.p1: After 25 years amid the concrete and crowds of Istanbul, our founder Halil İbrahim Demirel settled in Sakarya in 2015 and realized what he was looking for was simple: a natural, simple life amid greenery.
about.p2: We acquire zoned land in Sakarya's rural settlements, design the projects, obtain building permits, and complete all official processes to prepare floor-ownership deeds. We also carry out infrastructure, on-site roads and plot arrangements.
about.p3: Together with you, we tour these projects across 20+ locations, help you choose your plot, work with our architect on your home's plan, and finally build a payment model suited to your budget before handing over your title deed.
about.mission: To reconnect people with nature's healing power, without cutting them off from the conveniences of city life, by creating safe, sustainable, nature-in-harmony modern living spaces in rural Sakarya.
about.vision: To be the pioneer of an approach that builds the future not with concrete but with soil, nature and peace — the first and most trusted name that comes to mind when "nature-focused living" is mentioned in Turkey.

faq.q1: Are the plots zoned and permitted?
faq.a1: Yes. All plots in our projects are zoned; building permits are obtained by us and the floor-ownership deed is prepared.
faq.q2: Do I choose the home's design?
faq.a2: Yes. After choosing your plot, you work with our architect on your home's floor plan.
faq.q3: Is there an easy payment / installment option?
faq.a3: Yes. We offer flexible payment plans suited to your budget. Contact us for details.
faq.q4: Can I have construction done by another company?
faq.a4: In some of our projects, once you receive the plot with infrastructure and permits ready, you can proceed to construction with any firm you choose.
